## Utilities

```{r}
library(msa)
library(Biostrings)
```

#### CDR3 Search

```{r}
# function def
CDR3_Search <- function(dat,
                        sequences,
                        insert_cost,
                        delete_cost,
                        substitute_cost){
  
  # Count junction_aa length
  # dat$junction_aa_length <- nchar(dat$junction_aa)
  
  # For each CDR3
  for (i in 1:length(seqs$sequence)){
    # Pull the name
    CDR3_ID <- seqs$sequence_id[i]
    # Pull the junction_aa
    CDR3 <- seqs$sequence[i]
    
    # calculate distance metric indexed by Query VHH name
    dat[[CDR3_ID]] <- stringdist::stringdist(seqs$sequence[i], 
                                             dat$junction_aa, 
                                             method = "lv",
                                        weight = c(insert_cost, 
                                                   delete_cost, 
                                                   substitute_cost))
  }
  return(dat)
}
  
```


#### Translate

```{r}
translate_DNA <- function(dna_data){
  clean_dna <- gsub("[^ACTG]", "", dna_data)
  DNA_strings <- Biostrings::DNAStringSet(clean_dna)
  translations <- as.character(Biostrings::translate(DNA_strings))
  return(translations)
}
```

#### Trim CDR3

```{r}
trim_CDR3 <- function(seq_vec){
  return(substr(seq_vec, 2, nchar(seq_vec)-1))
}
```

### Clean Data

```{r}
S1$junction_aa <- trim_CDR3(S1$junction_aa)
S2$junction_aa <- trim_CDR3(S2$junction_aa)
S3$junction_aa <- trim_CDR3(S3$junction_aa)
```

### Perform CDR3 Search

```{r}
S1_res <- CDR3_Search(S1,
                      seqs,
                      insert_cost = 1,
                      delete_cost = 1,
                      substitute_cost = 0.05)

S1_res$experiment <- rep("S1", each = nrow(S1_res))

S2_res <- CDR3_Search(S2,
                      seqs,
                      insert_cost = 1,
                      delete_cost = 1,
                      substitute_cost = 0.05)

S2_res$experiment <- rep("S2", each = nrow(S2_res))

S3_res <- CDR3_Search(S3,
                      seqs,
                      insert_cost = 1,
                      delete_cost = 1,
                      substitute_cost = 0.05)

S3_res$experiment <- rep("S3", each = nrow(S3_res))

rm(S1, S2, S3)
```

### Find closest Clonal Familes for Each Query

* **Note:** This only pulls the _first_ minimum distanced `clone_id` right now

```{r}
pull_clone_id_and_junction <- function(dat, seqs){
  results <- data.frame()

  for (nm in unique(seqs$sequence_id)){
    results <- rbind(results, cbind(nm,
                                    seqs[seqs$sequence_id == nm,]$sequence,
                                    dat[which.min(dat[[nm]]),]$clone_id,
                                    dat[which.min(dat[[nm]]),]$junction_aa,
                                    dat[which.min(dat[[nm]]),]$experiment,
                                    dat[which.min(dat[[nm]]),]$sequence_alignment))
  }
  
  colnames(results) <- c("sequence_id", 
                         "sequence",
                         "clone_id",
                         "junction_aa", 
                         "experiment",
                         "sequence_alignment")
  
  return(results)
  
}

results <- rbind(pull_clone_id_and_junction(S1_res, seqs),
                 pull_clone_id_and_junction(S2_res, seqs),
                 pull_clone_id_and_junction(S3_res, seqs))


# Create an "all results" variable
all_res <- rbind(S1_res, S2_res, S3_res)
```


```{r}
for (nm in unique(results$sequence_id)){
  print(nm)
  print(results[results$sequence_id == nm,])
  cat('\n')
}
```


## Subset clones for each Sequence_id

1. Subset for each sequence id based on clone

2. Calculate levenshtein distance for each

3. Order by distance

4. Compute multiple sequence alignment

#### Pull clones for a given sequence

```{r}
res_list <- list()

# Cluster by experiment
for (experiment_set in unique(results$experiment)){
  
  tmp_results <- results[results$experiment == experiment_set,]
  
  # Then by clones
  for (nm in tmp_results$sequence_id){
      # Create an empty spot if it doesn't exist
      if (is.null(res_list[[nm]])) res_list[[nm]] <- data.frame()
      # Subset clones
      tmp <- all_res[all_res$clone_id == tmp_results[tmp_results$sequence_id == nm,]$clone_id,]
      
      # Remove duplicate junction_aas (for now)
      tmp <- tmp[!duplicated(tmp$junction_aa),]
      
      # Subset relevant information
      tmp <- tmp[order(tmp[[nm]], decreasing = F), c("sequence_id",
                                                     "junction_aa",
                                                     "sequence_alignment",
                                                      nm,
                                                     "experiment")]
      
      # Correct distance to the # of substitutions
      tmp[[nm]] <- tmp[[nm]]/0.05
      
      tmp$sequence_id <- paste(nm, ':', tmp$sequence_id, sep = '')
      # Add new columns
      tmp$Query_VHH_id <- rep(nm, each = nrow(tmp))
      tmp$Query_VHH_CDR3 <- rep(seqs[seqs$sequence_id == nm,]$sequence)
      
      colnames(tmp) <- c("DB_sequence_id", 
                         "DB_VHH_CDR3",
                         "DB_sequence_alignment",
                         "distance",
                         "experiment",
                         "Q_VHH_id",
                         "Q_VHH_CDR3")
      
      #print(nm)
      #print("All CDR3's the same length?")
      #print(all(nchar(tmp$DB_VHH_CDR3) == nchar(tmp$Q_VHH_CDR3)))
      
      tmp <- tmp[nchar(tmp$DB_VHH_CDR3) == nchar(tmp$Q_VHH_CDR3),]
      
      #Translate
      tmp$DB_sequence_alignment <- translate_DNA(tmp$DB_sequence_alignment)
      # Chop off front
      tmp$DB_sequence_alignment <- substr(tmp$DB_sequence_alignment, 7, nchar(tmp$DB_sequence_alignment))
      # Drop premature stop codons
      tmp <- tmp[which(!grepl("\\*", tmp$DB_sequence_alignment, fixed = F)),]
      
      ## Rearrange columns
      tmp <- tmp[,c("Q_VHH_id", 
                    "Q_VHH_CDR3",
                    "DB_VHH_CDR3",
                    "distance",
                    "DB_sequence_alignment",
                    "DB_sequence_id",
                    "experiment")]
      
      # Store in results
      res_list[[nm]] <- rbind(res_list[[nm]], tmp)
    }
}


```


## Sequence Alignments

1. Iterate over the list of datasets

2. perform MSA on assembled VHHs

3. Write csv

## Sequence Alignment

```{r}
for (nm in names(res_list)){
  print(nm)
  # Create a data frame with amino acid sequences
  tmp <- res_list[[nm]]
  VHH_results <- data.frame()
  
  for (experiment_id in unique(tmp$experiment)){
    
      tmp <- tmp[tmp$experiment == experiment_id,]
      
      if (nrow(tmp) > 0){
          # Convert the data frame to an AAStringSet object
          sequences <- AAStringSet(tmp$DB_sequence_alignment)
          # Perform multiple sequence alignment
          msa_result <- msa(sequences, method = "ClustalOmega")
          # Store aligned results
          tmp$Aligned_VHHs <- as.character(msa_result@unmasked)
          # Substitute spaces for the - characters
          tmp$Aligned_VHHs <- gsub('-', ' ', tmp$Aligned_VHHs)
          
          ## Convert distance to a percentage
          # tmp$distance <- 100 - ((tmp$distance/nchar(tmp$DB_VHH_CDR3))*100)
          
          # Write
          VHH_results <- rbind(VHH_results, tmp)
      } else {
        cat("Unable to find match for: ", nm, '\n')
      }
  }
  
      print("Writing...")
      print(nm)
      VHH_results <- VHH_results[order(VHH_results$distance, decreasing = F),]
      # Drop exact matches
      VHH_results <- VHH_results[VHH_results$distance != 0,]
      file_name <- paste("~/Desktop/Shoemaker Lab/VHH_",nm,"_NK2018_clustering_CDR3_results20Jan24.csv", sep = '')
      write.csv(VHH_results, file_name, row.names = F)
      cat('Written.\n')
      cat('\n')
}



```
